content:
Recycler is a delay module for ORAC that focuses on reshaping the feedback signal to create more interesting rhythmic and textural delay patterns.

Although I personally enjoy using it more aggressively on simple percussive loops (to create interesting textural grooves), it can also be used in more subtly in order to add a bit of character to the feedback loop.

Features:
- Up to 1sec delay
- Dry/wet & Feedback controls
- High pass and Low Pass filters
- Frequency Shifter (with built-in LFO)
- Bit Crusher (Sample Rate / Bit Depth)
- Ducking
